exposure: high-dose erythropoietin (EPO) combined with therapeutic hypothermia (TH)
outcome: developmental outcomes (Denver II, Gross Motor Function Classification Score)
Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development, third edition (BSID-III) scores (cognitive, language, motor)
cohort: Term newborns with moderate to severe hypoxic-ischemic-encephalopathy (HIE) admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit between April 2018 and April 2022.
finding: Therapeutic hypothermia (TH) combined with high-dose erythropoietin (EPO) did not reduce brain injury on MRI or the risk of neurological sequelae in term infants with moderate to severe HIE, regardless of whether TH was initiated early (within six hours) or later (six to 12 hours).
